method.name: ES-MDA
method.source: Ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation, Emerick and Reynolds (2013), Computers & Geosciences 55:3-15: Na iterations, each assimilating the observations with error covariance inflated by alpha = Na, perturbed observations per member; the iterative ensemble Kalman inversion of Iglesias, Law and Stuart (2013), Inverse Problems 29:045001. Parameters are log multipliers on the regionalised fields (the NWM calibration convention of scaling spatial parameter fields, Cosgrove et al. 2024, JAWRA 60(2):247-272).
method.observation_transform: natural log of block-mean discharge; Gaussian error of standard deviation obs_error_log (0.10 = about 10 percent)

parameters.name: k_nash
parameters.meaning: subsurface Nash cascade coefficient (1/h): sets how fast lateral flow reaches the channel

parameters.name: k_lf
parameters.meaning: lateral flow coefficient (m/h at full drainable storage)

parameters.name: refkdt
parameters.meaning: Schaake et al. (1996) infiltration parameter; the CFE constant refkdt * satdk / 2e-6 scales with it

parameters.name: percolation
parameters.meaning: drainage coefficient slop; percolation to groundwater satdk * slop * 3600 scales with it

parameters.name: cgw
parameters.meaning: groundwater bucket coefficient (m/h)

parameters.name: gw_expon
parameters.meaning: groundwater bucket exponent

parameters.name: gw_zmax
parameters.meaning: groundwater bucket depth (m); the initial storage keeps its fraction of it

parameters.name: manning_n
parameters.meaning: Manning n of channel and compound channel (t-route MC columns n, ncc)

parameters.name: noah_bexp
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: Clapp-Hornberger b of every Noah-OWP soil layer (soil water retention and conductivity curve)

parameters.name: noah_dksat
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: saturated hydraulic conductivity of every layer (m/s); saturated diffusivity and kdt = refkdt dksat(1)/refdk keep their ratio

parameters.name: noah_lai
parameters.source: NOAA-OWP ngen-cal Noah-OWP-Modular + CFE calibration examples
parameters.meaning: monthly leaf and stem area index (dynamic_veg_option 1 reads them): canopy interception capacity and transpiration

parameters.name: noah_ch2op
parameters.source: NOAA-OWP ngen-cal Noah-OWP-Modular + CFE calibration examples
parameters.meaning: canopy water storage capacity per unit leaf and stem area (mm): how much rain the canopy holds back and evaporates

parameters.name: noah_cwp
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: canopy wind parameter CWPVT (within-canopy wind and turbulent exchange)

parameters.name: noah_vcmx25
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: maximum carboxylation rate at 25 C (stomatal conductance and transpiration)

parameters.name: noah_mp
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: slope of the Ball-Berry conductance-photosynthesis relation

parameters.name: noah_hvt
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: canopy top height (m); canopy bottom keeps its ratio

parameters.name: noah_mfsno
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: snowmelt m parameter of the snow-cover fraction curve (how fast cover shrinks as snow melts)

parameters.name: noah_scamax
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: maximum fractional snow-covered area

parameters.name: noah_rsurf_snow
parameters.source: Cosgrove et al. (2024), JAWRA 60(2):247-272 (NWM v3 calibration parameter list)
parameters.meaning: surface resistance of snow to sublimation (s/m)

parameters.name: noah_bvic
parameters.source: Liang et al. (1994) VIC b; Noah-MP dynamic VIC runoff (runoff_option 8, the hydro-world namelist)
parameters.meaning: VIC infiltration-capacity shape b of the dynamic VIC scheme (runoff_option 8); refkdt is the Schaake control and is inactive under this option

parameters.name: noah_gdvic
parameters.source: Noah-MP dynamic VIC (runoff_option 8) GDVIC, mean capillary drive (m)
parameters.meaning: mean capillary drive of the dynamic VIC / Philip infiltration (dynamic_vic_option 1)

layout: full column: Noah-OWP land-model rows (noah_fields, the f32 parameter rows of the Noah-OWP slab, gpuwm/hydro/noahowp/schema.json) are members of the same stacked realization as the CFE and routing rows; forcing and PET stay shared. The CFE/routing-only table calibration-parameters.v1.json is the door default; this table is selected with request.parameters.
noah_note: Noah-OWP passes its surface water input (water.qinsur: throughfall plus snowmelt) to CFE, which partitions infiltration; Noah-OWP soil and infiltration rows reach the gauges only through the land energy and snow budget. Their sensitivity is measured in each calibration (prior-ensemble correlation, receipt) rather than assumed.
